verdict.rationale: SES docs say you can lease dedicated IPs reserved for your exclusive use, giving you full control over sender reputation. Its Managed dedicated IPs are set up automatically, warm up per ISP individually, and auto-scale with sending volume, which covers the automated ramp-up the story asks for. One older community post says SES offers no dedicated IPs, but current docs directly document leasing them, so it does not concretely dispute the capability. Missing for 10: details of the warmup process or a published schedule for standard (non-managed) dedicated IPs, and independent hands-on confirmation that automated warmup works.
